'''KU-HeeHee''' is a KU-Roro found below the cliff side of the Tethys Hub. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''KU-Goodie:''' You may keep your concern! The weak version of me has already died! Call me KU-Goodie the Treasure Hunter now!
:'''KU-Goodie:''' Well... it's easier said than done... How do I find that portal?
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing here?
::'''KU-Goodie:''' Wahhh! It's {{Rover}}! Hi there! Are you also interested in the legend of the Shore's treasure?
::{{DIcon}} What is this legend about?
:{{DIcon}} (Turn around to leave.)
:'''KU-Goodie:''' You must have seen those special portals around the Black Shores, I guess?
:'''KU-Goodie:''' They may look like ordinary doors, but when you open one, it's actually connected to another door somewhere else!
:'''KU-Goodie:''' Though we don't know exactly how these portals work, they save us a lot of commuting time.
:{{DIcon}} I've seen them before.
:{{DIcon}} I've never seen them before.
:'''KU-Goodie:''' There's an urban legend going around on the Black Shores' internal forum, claiming that these portals are actually bugs caused by some glitch. 
:'''KU-Goodie:''' Supposedly, a "secret maze" is hidden deep within the Black Shores, accessible by triggering these bugs in a certain way.
:'''KU-Goodie:''' And... there are treasures hidden inside!
:'''KU-Goodie:''' I'm linked to the Tethys System as the Black Shores' cleaning robot, but I don't have access to the information for every room here.
:'''KU-Goodie:'''Come to think of it, is it even possible for the Black Shores' system to have bugs...
:'''KU-Goodie:'''Anyway, I really want to see that "secret maze" and those "hidden treasures" for myself if I can.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Note==
*Ku-Goodie may be referring to the [[The Hidden Treasure of the Black Shores]].
